$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the item-kind vocabulary shared by the bridges and the CLI. Every kind string the C# ItemKind.Map can emit is listed here. A bare entry => the CLI materializes it as a workspace file (or folder) and MUST have a matching packages/volt-git/src/registry/extensions.ts entry. Every writable source kind is named by KIND (function_block→.fb, program→.prg, function→.fun, interface→.itf, DUTs→.struct/.enum/.union/.alias, gvl→.gvl; bridge: ItemKind.ExtFor). A POU's body language is NOT in the extension: an editable FBD/LD body is the same .fb/.prg/.fun (graphical detected by the NETWORK marker) and a read-only CFC/SFC body is that kind extension too, self-described by a `READONLY <LANG>` body marker. Kind is recovered from file content on push. Read-only reference kinds keep their own extension (defaultAccess `r`). The only kinds that carry a `family` are the exceptions that DON'T become files: family inlined => the item lives inside a POU's ST text; family container => a wire kind that is never materialized. Enforced by packages/volt-git/src/tests/vocabulary.test.ts, which cross-checks this file against ItemKind.cs (the bridge): changing one without the other fails the test.
